Named restart conditions: ① a second measured adjacent-id conflict actually ejecting a PR from the queue (frequency evidence changes the cost side); ② #7464 (the same question on `conversions/registry.ts`) being taken up — decide both registries in one design rather than twice; ③ any ruling revisiting #6957. Until one fires, this stays a written-down fact, which is what the filer asked it to be.
